purpose: Merged pull requests in public Bitwarden repositories that introduced a bug a later pull request fixed. The buggy lines are added lines in the original diff. expected_location uses new-side line numbers in the file at head_sha. bug_summary is given to the grader to confirm a hit describes the same defect. See ./README.md for the run flow and scoring.

evals.pr_title: [PM-31406] Migrate lastpass importer to special-purpose dangerous-crypto-compat
evals.bug_summary: decryptAes256 replaced Utils.fromArrayToUtf8 with Utils.fromArrayToByteString (Latin-1 byte mapping), so any multi-byte UTF-8 character in LastPass-imported Vault Data is corrupted.

Bulk restore fetches data-ownership-enforced org user IDs before restoring; the users are still Revoked (an exempt status), so the Contains check at line 244 is never true and no default collection is created on bulk restore.

The salt changed from STANDARD.encode(salt) (a String) to B64::from(...), whose as_bytes() returns the decoded raw bytes, so the export key is derived from a different salt than other clients use and password-protected exports cannot be decrypted by them.

evals.pr_title: [PM-34155] Enhance policy service with accepted policies retrieval and update sync response structure for new sync response
evals.bug_summary: syncNewPolicies returns early when both policiesNew and policies are empty, so newPolicyService state is never cleared and stale policies keep being enforced after all policies are removed.

evals.pr_title: [PM-28150] fix: Log out accounts without unlock methods on app restart
evals.bug_summary: The explicit startup check (timeout action == .logout and timeout != .never) was replaced with checkSessionTimeouts, which relies on hasPassedSessionTimeout; that never fires for .onAppRestart, so 'log out on app restart' accounts are only locked.
